- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (high sentiment > 0.6) — reduce forecast peak values by 2–5%.
- Underestimate prices after sharp spikes (especially >75) — add 1–3% buffer to prevent premature correction.
- Overshoot in early forecast horizon (1–5 days) — apply downward bias of 1–3% if sentiment is neutral or slightly bearish.
- Mean-reversion bias: if forecast is >10% above recent 5-day average, reduce by 1–2% unless sentiment strongly bullish.
- Lagged sentiment effect: if sentiment drops below 0.4 after 3–5 days, reduce forecast by 1–2% to reflect weakening momentum.
- Avoid overconfidence in high sentiment + high price momentum — cap forecast growth rate at 1.5x recent average if sentiment > 0.7.
